title: Check yourself: The HTTP contract under every SDK

questions.stem: A team hand-writes a client in a language that has no SDK. The request carries the content type and the key, and the body copies the documentation's example, yet every call fails with a 400. Which addition is most likely missing?

options.text: The version header that names the API revision in use by the caller
options.says: The overview lists the version header as required, and a hand-written client has to send it itself.

options.text: An accept header that names the media type the client wants back
options.says: Ruled out because "Authentication, version and body type are all a plain request needs", and the media type of the reply is not among them.

options.text: A user-agent header that names the client library and its version
options.says: Ruled out because "the overview marks no Accept or User-Agent header as required", and the SDKs add that header for their own sake.

options.text: A workspace header that names the workspace this call should run under
options.says: Ruled out because the workspace header is needed "only when the key spans several workspaces".

questions.stem: A gateway between a service and the provider starts answering some failures with web pages. The service's failure handler throws while decoding them. Which design is best?

options.text: Decode the body as JSON first and stop the process whenever that decoding fails
options.says: Ruled out because "a hand-written client must keep working when the body is HTML".

options.text: Ask the gateway team to promise that every reply stays JSON in the provider's own format
options.says: Ruled out because "always JSON is the API's promise about its own errors", and a gateway is not covered by it.

options.text: Map each non-2xx status to a typed fault, using the raw text if the body is not JSON
options.says: A hand-written client has to cope with a non-JSON body, so the handler falls back to the text.

options.text: Retry each failing call until the body decodes cleanly into the expected shape
options.says: Ruled out because "the proxy answers the same page again".
